description: Intent i002 (branch=xmit-softirq-lock, snapshot=s01) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:1989-1994, quote "mwl8k_tx_count_packet(sta, tid);\n\t\tspin_lock(&priv->stream_lock);\n\t\tstream = mwl8k_lookup_stream(hw, sta->addr, tid);". Lock priv->stream_lock is taken with plain spin_lock() at every one of its 10 acquisition sites (1992/2056/2079/2129 in mwl8k_txq_xmit; 3835-3853 in the mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events workqueue worker queued from hardirq mwl8k_interrupt:4620; 4165-4184 in mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del sta-removal path; 5461+ in mwl8k_ampdu_action cfg80211 process context) with no spin_lock_bh anywhere. Softirq side: ieee80211_ops .tx = mwl8k_tx (4691-4706, registered 5613) -> mwl8k_txq_xmit -> plain spin_lock(&priv->stream_lock), reachable from ndo_start_xmit/ieee80211_subif_start_xmit and TX dequeue under NET_TX softirq; the same function takes priv->tx_lock with spin_lock_bh (2054/2115), proving the xmit path runs with BH enabled and the stream_lock sites are the missing-bottom-half-disable pattern. Untrusted trigger: ordinary local/remote data traffic (runs .tx) plus any firmware BA-watchdog event, sta removal, or ampdu action that puts a worker/task on the lock — a NET_TX softirq on that CPU then spins forever on stream_lock against a holder that can never resume: soft lockup, RCU stall, TX-stall DoS; exact seed shape (ks7010 tx_dev_lock, commit 058cbee52ccd). Safe classifications: ks7010_sdio.c:398 (seed, present unpatched in s01 but excluded per rule); hostap hostap_ap.c sta_table_lock plain sites are themselves the tasklet/softirq side while all process sites use spin_lock_bh (safe ordering); cw1200 wsm.c bss_loss_lock/wsm_cmd.lock/event_queue_lock pair the cw1200_bh kthread with workqueue workers — process context on both sides, no softirq side. Unresolved (not fully paired before deadline): iwlwifi pcie/rx.c irq_lock/rxq->lock (1013/1046/1490), ath9k main.c intr_lock/pcu_lock/pm_lock, mt76 tx.c q->lock (464/486/495), ath5k base.c txbuflock/txq->lock, qtnfmac trans.c resp_lock (30/47/87/136). Limitations: static hypothesis only (no .config to build mwl8k standalone, no runtime PoC); enumeration bounded to drivers/net/wireless and drivers/staging; timer/tasklet branch analogs only incidentally covered.
